claims.statement: Portrait of a woman widely identified as Lisa del Giocondo. The Vespucci note of October 1503 is the main contemporary evidence. The painting was probably worked on over many years.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Vespucci note, 1503; stylistic and technical study.
